login-page.description: Public login page: one RUT input, one password input, one native submit in a top-level POST form.

business-selector.description: Authenticated convention selector: one table row per business; the visible convention link is the business ID and the last cell its label.

provider-error.description: System-error page served with HTTP 200 at the selector route.

dashboard.description: Shell dashboard of the selected business inside the fe-oss-shell-dashboard frame.

movements.description: Movements view inside fe-oss-shell-mov-cuenta: exactly one account widget heading and a sibling download control whose accessible name is Descargar followed by an icon-font glyph.

download-menu.description: Menu opened by the first visible Descargar control; exactly one Excel detallado option.

successConditions: businesses.list: at least one business row with non-empty unique ID and label
accounts.options: exactly one account heading matching 7-20 digits inside the movements frame
cartolas.download: one browser download event whose file passes signature, ZIP CRC, XLSX structure and detailed-column checks
stopConditions: login rejection or ambiguity before acceptance
CAPTCHA, MFA, Turnstile, rate limiting, or account block
system-error page at the selector route (missing or expired session, not a missing row)
missing or duplicate business rows or IDs
selected business not present in current discovery
current account not matching the exact discovered account ID
missing download event or invalid document signature
